title: Strategic Threads: Company-Level OKR Stitching and Rapid Escalation Path
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Company-level OKRs are set broadly but execution often fragments across product, infra, and ops teams. We need a lightweight, repeatable protocol to 'stitch' initiatives to company OKRs, surface cross-team dependencies early, and provide a fast escalation path when initiative slippage threatens objective delivery.

Goal: Create a documented playbook + tooling pattern that product managers and leads use during roadmap planning and cycle kickoff to: 1) declare initiative->OKR mappings with measurable milestones, 2) register dependencies and owners, 3) establish gating and escalation rules, and 4) produce an OKR execution ledger that feeds the weekly leadership sync and the Console/roadmap dashboard.

Outcomes:
- Single source mapping of initiatives->company OKRs with RACI and milestone SLOs.
- Reduced late-stage surprises: 80% of high-impact cross-team dependencies registered before cycle start.
- Clear escalation path (automated alert + named escalation owner + 48-hour triage SLA) for objectives at risk.
acceptance_criteria: Draft runbook published in Confluence with step-by-step checklist for PMs and Eng leads
Dependency registry template created (CSV + sample Airtable view) and seeded with initial FY26 Q1 initiatives
Escalation flow defined with roles (PM Lead, Eng TPM, L2 Ops, Head of Product) and an email + Slack channel template
Integration doc linked for Roadmap dashboard: a weekly extract shows initiative status, % milestone complete, and OKR risk flag
Two pilot product groups complete the runbook during cycle planning and report feedback
Leadership review scheduled and feedback incorporated

2026-02-25 | Marco Nguyen: Incorporated Priya's field; added 'deployment-sensitivity' tag and a severity tier (low/med/high). Updated acceptance criteria to include seeding with FY26 Q1 initiatives.
2026-03-01 | Jan Novak (Design): Requested examples of initiative milestones that map to measurable user outcomes. Added requirement for each initiative to include a canonical metric and target.

2026-03-03 | Aisha Patel: Ran first pilot with Search infra and Console product teams. Findings: 1) 3 cross-team deps registered, 2) one high-severity infra gating item discovered early (saves estimated 2-week delay), 3) scoreboard export requires a minor transform for legacy Roadmap fields. Next: Marcos (Data Eng) to add transform by 3/10.
2026-03-05 | Marco Nguyen: Updated checklist to require an owner for each dependency and an expected resolution ETA. Preparing leadership review deck for 3/11 sync.
decisions: Use Airtable as the canonical dependency registry for the pilot (decision: 2026-02-12)
Introduce 'deployment-sensitivity' tag (low|medium|high) to prioritize infra-heavy initiatives (decision: 2026-02-25)
Escalation SLA set to 48 hours for triage, 5 business days for committed mitigation plan (decision: 2026-02-28)
Roadmap dashboard will ingest a weekly CSV export from the registry; Data Eng will own transformation (decision: 2026-03-03)
For now, keep runbook lightweight — no mandatory gating meetings for P2 initiatives; P0/P1 require canary mitigation plan attached to initiative entry (decision: 2026-03-04)
